raw_comment:
I notice that many of the severe droughts are towards the middle of the US.

I wonder how come the middle part of the US is experiencing severe droughts and how the people within those areas are dealing with this.

This relates to me because I have a family member in Texas so I would like to see how they are going through this.

A catchy headline or title would be ''Severe Drought Conditions in the US.''
